blocks: Before the recording, codekiln heard pressure "really impact the volume." The saved matrix has no pressure route to level, so that impression may come from the Shape modulation or from the session's edits; the export cannot settle it.

Base controls use normalized 0…1 values unless a stored choice code is shown; matrix amounts use −1…+1. These describe saved base settings before modulation, not OLED percentages, hertz or milliseconds.
Microfreak/CLI/Inspect a preset preserves the original fields. Oscillator interpretation assumes the documented firmware 5 layout; firmware is not detected from the export.
Matrix columns and assignments follow the Freakout live map and assignment decoder. Mode, LFO shape and octave labels follow the MicroFreak Reader definitions.
Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations explains matrix sources, destinations and the expression row.
Saved export: read from the device's slot 152 over USB on October 25, 2026 with mise run microfreak:download --slot 152. Two consecutive reads returned the same file.

The parameter payload matches the MIDI Control Center archives Factory 2.0, Factory 2.1, Factory 3.0 (Factory 2.0 slot 127, Factory 2.1 slot 229, Factory 3.0 slot 229). Comparison used mise run microfreak:compare.
Download the slot 152 capture. It is the raw device format (header plus data packets), not an .mbp file; see Microfreak/Preset/152 B3/Asset/Device-Read-2026-10-25/bin.
